lines.zh: 我压着头走，脖子伸向前
lines.en: Head low, I push my neck forward.

lines.zh: 两片红冠在光里很显眼
lines.en: The two red crests show clearly in the light.
Three toes cross cracked red earth.

lines.zh: 这是我每天巡视的界线
lines.en: This is the boundary I walk each day.
I do not run; I close in slowly.
Tail level, I sweep the low grass.
I move between the rock pillars.
Gravel rolls away under my step.
I pause to read the wind.

lines.zh: 旱地的热气从地面升起来
lines.en: Heat rises off the dry ground.
I walk the edge of the nest.
My claws leave marks.

lines.zh: 步幅很大，但没什么声音
lines.en: Long strides, but little sound.
I go around a clump of dry grass.

lines.zh: 我在旱地上走成一条直线
lines.en: I walk a straight line across dry ground.

lines.zh: 脚掌落下去，尘土跳起来
lines.en: My foot lands and dust jumps.
I stand with my crests to the sun.
A stir in the nest; I turn.
I stand with my red crest toward the sun.
I open my jaws and show my teeth.
Wind drives sand into my scales.
I do not sleep deeply; one eye closes.
An old claw mark on the dead wood.
I listen for movement underground.
The butte's shadow creeps along.
A group of small things far off.
I guard my nest.
My breathing is long.

lines.zh: 我低着头，像在打量地面
lines.en: Head down, as if studying the ground.
You have entered my boundary.
My crests have risen.

lines.zh: 你站的地方是我的巡路
lines.en: You stand on my patrol path.
I know this dry land.
I am looking at the back of your knee.
My nest is over there.
I do not mean to call.

lines.zh: 这片孤峰归我，你的目光也算越界。
lines.en: These buttes are mine — even your gaze trespasses.
I hiss and turn my flank away.
A scale is torn up.
That pushed me back half a body.
I shake my head; blood hits the ground.
I drop low to guard my belly.
Pain makes me fiercer.
I can still hold my ground.
You hit harder than you look.
I gasp, and sand gets in my jaws.
I have your position marked.
Meat. I know that smell.

lines.zh: 沙漠的干林里，我巡这片。
lines.en: I patrol this dry desert woodland.
Throw it over; do not just stand.
I do not eat carrion.
There are young in my nest.
Back away, then I will come.
This piece will do.
I will not snatch from your hand.
Raw meat is more honest than anything.
My chest shoves you back.
My bones are heavier than you think.

lines.zh: 这一下撞掉了我一片鳞
lines.en: That knocked a scale loose.
We are wedged in the narrow pass.
I set my foot beside you.
Gravel scatters underfoot.
I did not mean to hurt you.
Do not press in at my flank.
The nest is right here.
We take turns guarding.
Two pairs of crests side by side.
This ground can raise our young.
I do not fight; I display.
She is quicker; I yield.
One short call is enough.
We must last the dry season together.
We hold the same boundary.
The young follow us.
I lower my head and sniff.
Not meat; I leave it.
I bite and shake my head.
It is pinned under my claw.
This thing is too hard.
I kick it aside.
What falls by the nest is mine.
No smell; I drop it.
The young ones would play with this.
You are still on my ground.
I have your flank.
I will not yield this step.
You are too near my nest.
The crests are my warning.
My territory runs to that stone.
You raised your hand first.
I strike fast.
You have your back to the nest.
I will follow you.
I count to three.
I keep to your rear flank.

lines.zh: 你每走一步都在我的地上
lines.en: Every step is on my ground.
Your prints are in the sand.
I need no speed; I use angles.
The back of your knee stays open.
Beyond the pillar is a dead end.
The deeper you retreat, the closer to my nest.
The wind keeps blowing toward you.
I do not call, and no pack comes.
I wait for you to turn.
Dust moves on dry ground.
I bite into your leg.
My claws pin you first.
This bite goes for the flank.
I butt your chest.
A head wrench opens a gash.
My toes kick sand up.
I climb your shield with my feet.
You blocked; my teeth skidded.
I break off and drop low again.

lines.zh: 这一击带着全身的重量
lines.en: That one carried my whole weight.
Block with that and my teeth will ache.
My tail sweeps your feet.

lines.zh: 我从孤峰的影子里出来
lines.en: I come out of the butte's shadow.

lines.zh: 红土上的热气扭曲了远处
lines.en: Heat haze warps the distance.

lines.zh: 我先走上石柱旁的界线
lines.en: First I walk the stone boundary.
The young are calling in the nest.
I shake the sand from my neck.
My crests warm in the light.
This dry land is mine to patrol again.
I sniff the old prints.
Wind draws the dust into a line.
The dead trees bear no leaves.
I stand a while before moving.

lines.zh: 领地里没有别的大家伙
lines.en: No other big thing in my territory.
I open my jaws to shed heat.
A low sound in my throat.
Fire scorches my crest, and it hurts.
I fall from the rock pillar.

lines.zh: 巨响把我掀翻在红土上
lines.en: The blast throws me onto the red earth.

lines.zh: 一根箭扎进我颈后的皮。
lines.en: An arrow lodges in the skin behind my neck.

lines.zh: 那股力量顺着鳞片进去了
lines.en: That force slips in along my scales.
Hungry enough to bite dry grass.

lines.zh: 旱地上落雷，我全身僵住
lines.en: Lightning on dry ground and I lock up.
No earth underfoot; nothing to grip.
